why did intel s operating margin decline.question: Why did Intel's operating margin decline in 2024?
why did intel s operating margin decline.answer:
Intel's operating margin fell from 0.2% in fiscal 2023 [1][2] to -22.0% in fiscal 2024 [3], down 22.2 percentage points. In its fiscal 2024 annual report (Item 7, Management's Discussion and Analysis), Intel attributes the change to the following:
- “Our consolidated gross margin in 2024 decreased by $4.4 billion, or 20%, compared to 2023 due primarily to higher 2024 impairment charges and accelerated depreciation.” [4]
- “To the extent we are unable to grow our revenues to offset these production costs, our gross margin and operating income will be unfavorably affected.” [5]
- “CCG operating expenses decreased $1.6 billion from 2022.” [6]
